1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.

2.name: Traumatic Burns
2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.

3.name: Fan the Flames
3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.

4.name: A Soul Ablaze
4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.

5.name: Burnished Scales
5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.

6.name: World in Ruin
6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon
7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.

8.name: The Storm Voice
8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

9.name: Heart of Stone
9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.

10.name: Landslide
10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.

11.name: Blessing at the Peak
11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

12.name: Mountain Giant
12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.

13.name: Inexorable Descent
13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

14.name: Wildfire Embers
14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Blood of the Elder Dragon
5.description:
Draw on your draconic blood to heal yourself for |cffffff8694|r and nearby allies for |cffffff5795|r Health, increasing by up to |cffffff50|r% additional healing based on missing Health. 

Healed targets gain Major Fortitude and Minor Courage, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff30|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff215|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

1.name: Combustion
1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.

2.name: Traumatic Burns
2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.

3.name: Fan the Flames
3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.

4.name: A Soul Ablaze
4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.

5.name: Burnished Scales
5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.

6.name: World in Ruin
6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon
7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r

8.name: The Storm Voice
8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff47|r Health
|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina

9.name: Heart of Stone
9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.

10.name: Landslide
10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.

11.name: Blessing at the Peak
11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

12.name: Mountain Giant
12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.

13.name: Inexorable Descent
13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

14.name: Wildfire Embers
14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Blood of the Elder Dragon
5.description:
Draw on your draconic blood to heal yourself for |cffffff8694|r and nearby allies for |cffffff5795|r Health, increasing by up to |cffffff50|r% additional healing based on missing Health. 

Healed targets gain Major Fortitude and Minor Courage, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff30|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff215|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

1.name: Combustion
1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.

2.name: Traumatic Burns
2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.

3.name: Fan the Flames
3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.

4.name: A Soul Ablaze
4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.

5.name: Burnished Scales
5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.

6.name: World in Ruin
6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon
7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff175|r

8.name: The Storm Voice
8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff41|r Health
|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina

9.name: Heart of Stone
9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.

10.name: Landslide
10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.

11.name: Blessing at the Peak
11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

12.name: Mountain Giant
12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.

13.name: Inexorable Descent
13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

14.name: Wildfire Embers
14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.

This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff14|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate

4.name: Igneous Weapons

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might

You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons

Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might

You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff41|r Health
|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff3325|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff3302|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff715|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff903|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate

Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff4689|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1007|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff7993|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff3325|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff41|r Health
|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel.

1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

To you, flame is fuel.

1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4650|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1009|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1298|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1419|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. 1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff539|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff8|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff21|r Health
|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4650|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1009|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1298|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate

Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6606|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons

Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1419|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11257|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff420|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff41|r Health
|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4650|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1009|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1298|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6606|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1419|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11257|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4650|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1009|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1298|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6606|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1419|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11257|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

1.effect:

If you are a vampire, the tainted blood in this drink will also spark a fierce hunger in you.

10.name: Landslide

11.description:

12.description:

12.name: Mountain Giant

14.name: Wildfire Embers

Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.

5.name: Burnished Scales

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon

9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5694|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5675|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7427|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7188|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2240|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11691|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4480|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5882|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8755|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3594|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff10175|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7177|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1075|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff154|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.
