1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff47|r Health
|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7106|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1065|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff47|r Health
|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7106|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1065|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5538|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5574|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7221|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff6990|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2196|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11372|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4394|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5721|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8510|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3495|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9885|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff6958|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1042|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5538|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5574|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7221|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff6990|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2196|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11372|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4394|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5721|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8510|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3495|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9885|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff6958|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1042|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:

9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff105|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

|cffffff46|r Magicka

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff3330|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2664|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff7510|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff300|r Magicka and |cffffff399|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff15|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1201|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff12390|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5632|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

29.bonus: |cffffff8|r% Critical Damage and Critical Healing done

1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.
1.name: Brawler

2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.
2.name: Magma Fist

3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.
3.name: Flame Lash

4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.
4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire

5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7106|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1065|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.
5.name: Burning Embers

6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.
6.name: Magma Shell

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

3.name: Flame Lash

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.
4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire

You heal for |cffffff6981|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1046|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

5.name: Burning Embers

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff47|r Health
|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5538|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5574|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.
1.name: Brawler

2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7221|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.
2.name: Magma Fist

3.description:

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11372|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4394|r Health.
3.name: Flame Lash

4.description:

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.
4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire

5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3495|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9885|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7030|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1054|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.
5.name: Burning Embers

6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.
6.name: Magma Shell

8.description:

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:

13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:

14.name: Wildfire Embers

3.name: Flame Lash

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.
4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire

5.description:

You heal for |cffffff6989|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1048|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

5.name: Burning Embers

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.
